title: A transaction valid at submission fails txBAD_AUTH at apply
pattern: Core applies a ledger's classic phase before its Soroban phase and re-checks the source account, sequence number, signatures and sequence-age preconditions at apply (TransactionFrame::commonValid; OperationFrame::checkSignature with forApply). Here a classic transaction earlier in the same ledger removes the only signer that signed this transaction, so it fails with txBAD_AUTH. Its sequence number is consumed and its fee charged.

hazards.placement: TransactionResult.txBAD_AUTH in a closed ledger: signer removed earlier in the ledger

facts.says: The transaction fails with tx_bad_auth although it was valid when submitted.
The transaction that caused it is in the same ledger.
The sequence number is consumed: the source account changes before apply.
No operation was applied: the operation meta is empty.
The transaction source is the account changed earlier in the ledger.
The unused resource fee is refunded after apply (two changes on the fee source).
